name: clawd-git
description: A live git panel beside the conversation: the file tree, changes, colored diffs and the commit graph; marks what Claude changed, stages, commits and asks Claude to review

autoOpen.title: Show on start
autoOpen.description: Show the git panel when a session starts. /git-pane shows or hides it.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the pane re-reads git while it is shown. It also refreshes right after each file edit or shell command.

icons.title: File icons
icons.description: auto: with a Nerd Font installed, line icons (VS Code's Codicons); else outline symbols when the fonts have them; else colored dots. line, nerd (colored file-type icons), outline, simple or off to force one.

background.title: Pane background
background.description: none (the default) keeps your terminal's own background. Or a hex color for a sidebar shade; pick one a step lighter than your terminal's, e.g. #1d1e20 on a #161718 terminal.

rows.title: Panel height (rows)
rows.description: With Placement set to prompt: how many rows the panel takes above the prompt, at most half the screen.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: side: a pane docked beside the conversation (fullscreen terminal). prompt: a panel inside the main screen, above the prompt.

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: How Open shows a file: auto tries code, cursor, zed, subl and phpstorm, then the system's opener. Or a command, with {file} and {line}, e.g. code -g {file}:{line}.
